mapper.sql: VAL_ID, PROD_ID, ASSET_ID, VALUE_DATE, MDATE, POS_AMT, TDY_COST_AMT, TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, TDY_INTINCEXP, DELAY_PAY_AMT, TDY_INTADJEXP_ADD, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_DEPT, ORG_CODE, DEPT_CODE, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_USER, STATUS, DATA_SOURCE,MD5PrimaryKey
mapper.select: select distinct COLUMN_NAME from information_schema.columns where Table_Name = #{tableName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select distinct CDATE cdate from PTL_SEC_VALUTION where ifnull(UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_TIME) > #{batchTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} order by cdate

select * from ( select aa.PROD_ID,aa.ASSET_ID,aa.VALUE_DATE,aa.MDATE,aa.ccy,sum(aa.POS_AMT) POS_AMT, sum(aa.TDY_COST_AMT) TDY_COST_AMT, sum(aa.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL) TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, sum(aa.TDY_INTINCEXP) TDY_INTINCEXP, sum(aa.DELAY_PAY_AMT) DELAY_PAY_AMT, max(aa.UPDATE_TIME) UPDATE_TIME, max(aa.CREATE_TIME) CREATE_TIME from ( select psv1.PROD_ID as PROD_ID, psv1.FINPROD_ID as ASSET_ID, psv1.ccy, psv1.VALUE_DATE as VALUE_DATE, ifnull(fp1.MDATE,fp2.MDATE) as MDATE, sum(psv1.POS_AMT) as POS_AMT, sum(psv1.TDY_COST_AMT) as TDY_COST_AMT, sum(psv1.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL) as TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, sum(psv1.TDY_INTINCEXP) as TDY_INTINCEXP, sum(psv1.DELAY_PAY_AMT) as DELAY_PAY_AMT, -- psv.DELAY_PAY_AMT as DELAY_PAY_AMT, max(psv1.UPDATE_TIME) UPDATE_TIME, max(psv1.CREATE_TIME) CREATE_TIME
from ( select psv.PORTFOLIO_ID as PROD_ID, ifnull(ifnull(fpf.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID), fp2.FINPROD_ID) as FINPROD_ID, psv.ccy, psv.CDATE as VALUE_DATE, (case fp.finprod_type when 'F01' then 100*psv.SHARE_AMT else psv.SHARE_AMT end) as POS_AMT, psv.DSC_COST_AMT as TDY_COST_AMT, psv.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL as TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, psv.TDY_INTINCEXP as TDY_INTINCEXP, psv.DELAY_PAY_AMT as DELAY_PAY_AMT, ifnull(psv.UPDATE_TIME,psv.CREATE_TIME) UPDATE_TIME, ifnull(psv.CREATE_TIME,psv.UPDATE_TIME) CREATE_TIME from PTL_SEC_VALUTION psv left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = psv.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fpf on fpf.FINPROD_ID = fp.P_FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT fp2 on fp2.FINPROD_ID = psv.FINPROD_ID and fp2.branch = 0 where DATE_FORMAT(CDATE,'%Y-%m-%d')= #{batchTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and (fp.IS_CHL !='Y' or fp.IS_CHL is null) and exists( select 1 from FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fp3 where fp3.PORTFOLIO_ID = psv.PORTFOLIO_ID) ) psv1 left join FIN_PRODUCT fp1 on fp1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = psv1.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT fp2 on fp2.FINPROD_ID = psv1.FINPROD_ID and fp2.branch = 0 group by psv1.PROD_ID,fp1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,psv1.VALUE_DATE,fp1.MDATE,fp2.MDATE,psv1.FINPROD_ID,psv1.ccy union select unqixi.PROD_ID, unqixi.ASSET_ID, unqixi.ccy, unqixi.VALUE_DATE, unqixi.MDATE, sum(unqixi.POS_AMT), sum(unqixi.TDY_COST_AMT), sum(unqixi.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL), sum(unqixi.TDY_INTINCEXP), sum(unqixi.DELAY_PAY_AMT), max(unqixi.UPDATE_TIME), max(unqixi.CREATE_TIME) from (select tpda.portfolio_id as PROD_ID, fp.finprod_market_id as ASSET_ID, tpd.ccy, tpd.trade_date as VALUE_DATE, fp.MDATE as MDATE, tpd.share_amt*100 as POS_AMT, tpd.fprice_amt as TDY_COST_AMT, 0 as TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, 0 as TDY_INTINCEXP, 0 as DELAY_PAY_AMT, ifnull(tpd.UPDATE_TIME, tpd.CREATE_TIME) UPDATE_TIME, ifnull(tpd.CREATE_TIME, tpd.UPDATE_TIME) CREATE_TIME from trd_product_deal tpd inner join fin_product fp on tpd.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id inner join trd_product_deal_add tpda on tpd.trade_id = tpda.trade_id left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.portfolio_id = tpda.portfolio_id where tpd.finprod_type = 'F01' and tpd.chl_id is not null and tpd.inv_aim = 'AC' and tpd.ps = 'T01' and tpd.trade_date < fp.vdate and DATE_FORMAT(tpd.trade_date,'%Y-%m-%d') = #{batchTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and pp.portfolio_id is not null) unqixi group by unqixi.PROD_ID, unqixi.ASSET_ID, unqixi.VALUE_DATE, unqixi.MDATE, unqixi.ccy)aa group by aa.PROD_ID,aa.ASSET_ID,aa.VALUE_DATE,aa.MDATE,aa.ccy ) a where a.ASSET_ID is not null

select ifnull(ifnull(FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,FP1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID),BSDP.BOOKSET_ID) as PROD_ID, BSDP.BUSI_ID as ASSET_ID, SUM(BSDP.TDY_INTADJEXP_ADD_B) AS TDY_INTADJEXP_ADD from BOK_STAT_DET_POSIITON BSDP left join FIN_PRODUCT FP ON BSDP.BOOKSET_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID AND FP.PROFIT_TYPE IN ('01','03') AND FP.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F16' AND FP.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F16' left join FIN_PRODUCT FP1 ON BSDP.BOOKSET_ID = FP1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND FP1.PROFIT_TYPE = '02' AND FP1.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F16' AND FP1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F16' where DATE_FORMAT(BSDP.BOOK_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d')= #{batchTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group by BSDP.BOOKSET_ID,BSDP.BUSI_ID,FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,FP1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID
mapper.delete: delete from CHB_ASSETS_BASIS_DATA where DATE_FORMAT(UPDATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d')
delete from CHB_ASSETS_BASIS_DATA_NOBTM where DATE_FORMAT(UPDATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d')
mapper.select:
select * from ( SELECT psv1.prod_id AS prod_id, /*产品代码*/ psv1.asset_id AS asset_id, /*资产代码*/ psv1.ccy AS ccy, /*币种*/ psv1.value_date AS value_date, /*日期*/ psv1.mdate AS mdate, /*资产到期日*/ SUM(ifnull(psv1.pos_amt,0)) AS pos_amt, /*当日持仓*/ SUM(ifnull(psv1.tdy_cost_amt,0)) AS tdy_cost_amt, /*当日成本*/ SUM(ifnull(psv1.tdy_float_ingpl,0)) AS tdy_float_ingpl, /*当日公允价值变动*/ SUM(ifnull(psv1.tdy_intincexp,0)) AS tdy_intincexp, /*当日累计应计利息余额*/ SUM(ifnull(psv1.delay_pay_amt,0)) AS delay_pay_amt, /*待清算款*/ MAX(psv1.update_time) AS update_time FROM ( SELECT c.finprod_market_id asset_id, /*资产代码*/ a.portfolio_id prod_id, /*产品代码*/ a.ccy ccy, /*币种*/ a.cdate value_date, /*日期*/ c.mdate mdate, /*资产到期日*/ a.share_amt pos_amt, /*当日持仓*/ a.dsc_cost_amt tdy_cost_amt, /*当日成本*/ a.tdy_float_ingpl tdy_float_ingpl, /*当日公允价值变动*/ a.tdy_intincexp tdy_intincexp, /*当日累计应计利息余额*/ a.delay_pay_amt delay_pay_amt, /*待清算款*/ ifnull(a.update_time,a.create_time) update_time FROM ptl_sec_valution a INNER JOIN fin_product b ON a.finprod_id = b.finprod_id LEFT JOIN fin_product c ON b.chl_finprod_id = c.finprod_id WHERE 1=1 AND b.chl_finprod_id IS NOT NULL AND DATE_FORMAT(a.cdate,'%Y-%m-%d')= #{batchTime,jdbcType= VARCHAR} AND exists( select 1 from FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fp3 where fp3.PORTFOLIO_ID = a.PORTFOLIO_ID) )psv1 GROUP BY psv1.asset_id, psv1.prod_id, psv1.ccy, psv1.value_date, psv1.mdate ) a where a.ASSET_ID is not null union all select * from ( select psv1.PROD_ID as PROD_ID, ifnull(ifnull(fpf.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,fp1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID),psv1.FINPROD_ID) as ASSET_ID, psv1.ccy, psv1.VALUE_DATE as VALUE_DATE, ifnull(fp1.MDATE,fp2.MDATE) as MDATE, sum(ifnull(psv1.POS_AMT,0)) as POS_AMT, sum(ifnull(psv1.TDY_COST_AMT,0)) as TDY_COST_AMT, sum(ifnull(psv1.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL,0)) as TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, sum(ifnull(psv1.TDY_INTINCEXP,0)) as TDY_INTINCEXP, sum(ifnull(psv1.DELAY_PAY_AMT,0)) as DELAY_PAY_AMT, max(psv1.UPDATE_TIME) UPDATE_TIME from ( select psv.PORTFOLIO_ID as PROD_ID, ifnull(ifnull(fp.P_FINPROD_ID,fp.FINPROD_ID),fp2.FINPROD_ID) as FINPROD_ID, psv.ccy, psv.CDATE as VALUE_DATE, (case fp.finprod_type when 'F01' then 100*psv.SHARE_AMT else psv.SHARE_AMT end) as POS_AMT, psv.DSC_COST_AMT as TDY_COST_AMT, psv.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL as TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, psv.TDY_INTINCEXP as TDY_INTINCEXP, psv.DELAY_PAY_AMT as DELAY_PAY_AMT, ifnull(psv.UPDATE_TIME,psv.CREATE_TIME) UPDATE_TIME from PTL_SEC_VALUTION psv left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = psv.FINPROD_ID and fp.chl_finprod_id is null left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT fp2 on fp2.FINPROD_ID = psv.FINPROD_ID and fp2.branch = 0 left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO info on info.sec_acct_id = psv.sec_acct_id where (psv.sec_acct_id='999999' or info.sec_acct_id is not null)
and DATE_FORMAT(psv.CDATE,'%Y-%m-%d')= #{batchTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and exists( select 1 from FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fp3 where fp3.PORTFOLIO_ID = psv.PORTFOLIO_ID) ) psv1 left join FIN_PRODUCT fp1 on fp1.FINPROD_ID = psv1.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT fpf on fpf.FINPROD_ID = fp1.P_FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT fp2 on fp2.FINPROD_ID = psv1.FINPROD_ID and fp2.branch = 0
where 1=1 group by psv1.PROD_ID,psv1.VALUE_DATE,ifnull(fp1.MDATE,fp2.MDATE),ifnull(ifnull(fpf.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,fp1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID),psv1.FINPROD_ID),psv1.ccy ) a where a.ASSET_ID is not null
SELECT F.FINPROD_MARKET_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT F LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T ON F.FINPROD_ID = T.FINPROD_ID WHERE T.TYPE_8='F02' AND T.TYPE_6='F01'
SELECT F.FINPROD_MARKET_ID FROM FIN_PRODUCT F WHERE F.FINPROD_TYPE = 'F01' and F.IS_RIGHT = 'Y'

select fp1.finprod_market_id from fin_product_add fpd inner join fin_product fp on fpd.appear_market_id = fp.finprod_market_id left join fin_product fp1 on fp1.finprod_id = fpd.finprod_id where fpd.appear_market_id = #{assetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and fp.finprod_type ='F01'
mapper.insert: insert into CHB_ASSETS_BASIS_DATA_NOBTM (VAL_ID, PROD_ID, ASSET_ID,CCY, VALUE_DATE, MDATE, POS_AMT, TDY_COST_AMT, TDY_FLOAT_INGPL, TDY_INTINCEXP, TDY_INTADJEXP_ADD, DELAY_PAY_AMT, REMARK, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_DEPT, ORG_CODE, DEPT_CODE, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_USER, STATUS, DATA_SOURCE, MD5PRIMARYKEY ) values (#{valId,jdbcType=CHAR}, #{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{assetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{ccy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{valueDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{mdate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{posAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{tdyCostAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{tdyFloatIngpl,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{tdyIntincexp,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{tdyIntadjexpAdd,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{delayPayAmt,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sysdate, sysdate, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{orgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{deptCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dataSource,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{md5primarykey,jdbcType=CHAR} )
